body:
Well I trust you that Silkypix is better at processing those particular raw fles. Thanks for the information, I will keep that in mind in case I ever need to work with that camera. 
I'm stil not 100% sure if you are just sharing the information (which is already useful indeed) or you expect that something changes in ART. If the latter, a good first step (not sufficient for sure, but probably necessay) would be to share some sample raw file that shows the problem, preferably containing a variety of colours and shot under the problematic conditions that you describe above.

Best
